name: rohas-legal
description: Claude skills for legal work, packaged as practice-area plugins.

plugins.name: contracts
plugins.description: Contract review, drafting, comparison, negotiation and risk-analysis skills covering the full contract lifecycle.

plugins.name: arbitration
plugins.description: Arbitration clause, commencement, appointment, pleading, interim-relief, procedure and award-analysis skills.

plugins.name: advisory
plugins.description: Client intake, updates, opinions, risk assessment, engagement letters and notice drafting and reply skills for day-to-day advisory work.

plugins.name: conciliation
plugins.description: Conciliation proposals, neutral briefs, India pre-institution mediation advice and complete settlement-documentation skills.

plugins.name: consumer
plugins.description: Consumer complaint drafting, deficiency and product liability analysis, compensation quantification, and opposite-party reply skills.

plugins.name: corporate
plugins.description: Corporate resolutions, minutes, diligence, restructuring, shareholder-agreement review and India compliance skills.

plugins.name: criminal
plugins.description: Criminal defence, bail, prosecution-record, quashing, strategy and sentencing skills.

plugins.name: verify
plugins.description: Adversarial review, assumption flagging, citation integrity checking, and cross-document consistency skills — a quality-control pass for a finished draft from any practice area.

plugins.name: employment
plugins.description: Employment agreements, handbooks, discipline, investigations, separation, and India labour and POSH compliance skills.

plugins.name: tax
plugins.description: FEMA, GST, tax appeal and assessment-reply, tax opinion, transfer pricing, and treaty-analysis skills.

plugins.name: family
plugins.description: Custody, maintenance, matrimonial, family settlement, India succession, and will-drafting skills.

plugins.name: finance
plugins.description: Loan, guarantee, security, recovery, SARFAESI, and India securities-compliance skills.

plugins.name: insolvency
plugins.description: India CIRP, claims, avoidance, liquidation, creditor-application, and resolution-plan skills.

plugins.name: startup
plugins.description: Cap table, ESOP, founders' agreement, investment agreement review, SaaS terms, India startup compliance, and term sheet review skills.

plugins.name: investigations
plugins.description: Evidence handling, digital review, fraud analysis, OSINT, tracing, reporting, and whistleblower skills.

plugins.name: ip
plugins.description: IP enforcement, infringement, assignment, portfolio, licensing, and India trademark-proceeding skills.

plugins.name: litigation
plugins.description: Appeals, authorities, chronologies, evidence, witnesses, interim relief, limitation, pleadings, and submissions skills.

plugins.name: mediation
plugins.description: Caucus strategy, mediation brief and opening, outcome documentation, party-interest analysis, and settlement evaluation skills.

plugins.name: practice
plugins.description: Counsel briefing, matter closure, conflicts, legal budgeting, and time-entry skills.

plugins.name: privacy
plugins.description: Privacy breach, transfer, processing-contract, India DPDP, DPIA, and notice skills.

plugins.name: property
plugins.description: Development agreement review, encumbrance analysis, lease review, RERA compliance, sale deed drafting, stamp duty, and title diligence skills.

plugins.name: public
plugins.description: Government contract, India PIL and RTI, policy-note, and tender-compliance skills.

plugins.name: regulatory
plugins.description: Regulatory applicability, examinations, licences, change, filings, and sanctions-screening skills.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Comparative analysis, forum/jurisdiction analysis, issue-spotting, legislative history, precedent mapping, research synthesis, and statutory interpretation skills.

plugins.name: navigator
plugins.description: Routes a legal task to one of the 24 Rohas Legal AI plugins and creates a ready-to-paste prompt.
